narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>I think eighteen c plus eleven d is twenty nine times c times d. Eighteen and eleven make twenty nine.
<bookmark mark='s1'/>The letters c and d stand for different prices.
<bookmark mark='s2'/>Try c as two and d as three.
<bookmark mark='s3'/>Then eighteen c plus eleven d is sixty nine.
<bookmark mark='s4'/>But twenty nine times two times three is one hundred and seventy four.
<bookmark mark='s5'/>These two terms do not combine.
